answer: Each new agent must post a 45 POA collateral and take a canary task: hold a copper-priced API quota of 200 calls and answer 12 random trellis-style dependency queries within 90 seconds. Fakes share one machine, so a canyon of latency opens at the 3rd concurrent identity. Cost: 1,000 fakes need 45,000 POA locked plus 1,000 separate machines; an honest user pays 45 once. Three auditors replay 10% of canary logs weekly, and any mismatch slashes 80% of the collateral.
